fit_reason: Whole 1986 Four Winns Horizon 190 powerboat on trailer, listed by a private owner.
findings: Dull, faded navy gelcoat on the hull sides and transom with a chalky look
Grime and dark staining on the underside of the swim platform
Worn, dirty blue finish and scuffs on the top of the swim platform
Discolored, grimy vinyl on the cockpit seats, especially the gray seat panels
Dirt and dust on the dash and console areas
Seller notes the interior needs some love
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Four Winns Horizon 190. The navy gelcoat on the hull and transom looks faded, and the cockpit vinyl and carpet could use a good cleaning. We do mobile pre-sale details with gelcoat polish and interior cleaning and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
